intro: Station-level guidance is based on the named Seoul and Busan hotel areas and the official operator/tourism pages below. Exact door-to-door times, fares, service dates, and transfer choices remain blank whenever they are not confirmed for the trip date. Re-check the official planner and live operator information before departure.

routes.title: ICN → Seoul Station · AREX Express
routes.route: Incheon Airport Terminal 1 or 2 → Seoul Station; continue to the Stanford Hotel Myeongdong area using a current Seoul Metro route planner.
routes.confirmedDuration: Official indexed information: about 43 minutes from T1 / 51 minutes from T2.
routes.officialDetails: Official AREX search-result information shows a promotional fare and separate regular fare values, but the live official page rendered as an error image in this research session. The fare is intentionally left blank rather than presenting an unstable current price as a trip quote.
routes.transferNote: The AREX terminates at Seoul Station, not at the hotel. The onward station choice depends on the booked hotel entrance and luggage.

routes.title: ICN → Seoul Station · AREX All-stop
routes.route: Incheon Airport Terminal 1 or 2 → Seoul Station; plan a separate onward subway/taxi/walk leg to the hotel.
routes.confirmedDuration: Official indexed information: about 59 minutes from T1 / 66 minutes from T2.
routes.officialDetails: AREX's official route information distinguishes the All-stop service from the Express service. The live route page was not readable as text in this research session; confirm current service and price directly.
routes.transferNote: No door-to-door hotel duration is confirmed. Carry luggage and station transfer time are not included in the listed train durations.

routes.title: ICN → Myeongdong · Airport Limousine 6015
routes.route: Route 6015 serves Myeongdong and lists stops including Lotte Hotel, IBIS Myeong-dong, Royal Hotel / Euljiro 1-ga, and Myeong-dong Station. Choose the stop that best fits the Stanford Hotel booking, then confirm the last walking leg.
routes.officialDetails: The operator page provides weekday/weekend timetables and real-time tracking links. Those departure times are live/date-sensitive and are not copied into this itinerary.
routes.transferNote: The 6015 stop list does not name Stanford Hotel as a stop. A specific door-to-door route or walking time is not confirmed.

routes.title: Myeongdong hotel area → Gyeongbokgung / Bukchon
routes.route: Target Gyeongbokgung Station on Line 3 (Exit 5 for the palace area) and Anguk Station on Line 3 (Exit 3 for Onion Anguk / Bukchon access). Use the live official route planner from the exact hotel entrance.
routes.officialDetails: Seoul Metro confirms Line 3 and the palace station exit; Onion's first-party page confirms Anguk Station Exit 3 for its branch. No hotel-door-to-door duration is established.
routes.transferNote: The exact start station and route from the hotel were not confirmed. The Tuesday palace closure remains a separate itinerary conflict.

routes.title: Myeongdong hotel area → COEX / Samseong
routes.route: COEX access: Samseong Station, Line 2, Exit 6. From Euljiro 1-ga (if this is the chosen hotel-area start), Line 2 continues toward Samseong; use the official route planner from the actual hotel entrance.
routes.officialDetails: Seoul Metro and Starfield identify Samseong Station Line 2 Exit 6 as a COEX access point. No travel time or hotel-door-to-door path is asserted.
routes.transferNote: COEX is a separate Gangnam cluster from Seongsu and DDP; avoid assuming they are walkable as a single stop group.

routes.title: Myeongdong hotel area → Seongsu businesses
routes.route: The Seongsu stores in the official listings are in the Seongsu area; use Seongsu Station and the relevant official store address as map targets. If starting at Euljiro 1-ga, follow the current Line 2 route planner.
routes.officialDetails: Official business pages identify the Seongsu addresses; no particular hotel-to-shop transfer duration was verified.
routes.transferNote: Seongsu is a separate neighborhood cluster from DDP and COEX. Sequence or visit day is not assigned in this site.

routes.title: Myeongdong hotel area → DDP
routes.route: Dongdaemun History & Culture Park Station is served by Lines 2, 4, and 5; Visit Seoul lists Exit 1 for DDP. Use the live route planner from the hotel.
routes.officialDetails: The DDP listing identifies the station lines and Exit 1. Exact route and duration from Stanford Hotel are not confirmed.
routes.transferNote: DDP's exhibitions and individual spaces may have their own hours/closures; general building hours are not a substitute.

routes.title: Namsan / N Seoul Tower shuttle
routes.route: The operator lists service to N Seoul Tower from nearby subway anchors including Chungmuro and Dongguk University stations.
routes.confirmedDuration: 01A interval about 9 minutes; 01B interval about 14 minutes. Operating window listed 06:30–23:00.
routes.officialDetails: These are operator-listed service details checked on 2026-10-21 and may change; use live service information on the travel day.
routes.transferNote: No hotel-specific route or cable-car connection time is estimated.

routes.title: Seoul Station → Busan Station · KTX
routes.route: KTO confirms the Gyeongbu Line connects Seoul and Busan. Select a dated departure and check live availability and fare on Korail.
routes.officialDetails: KTO says tickets are usually released about one month before departure and can generally be bought until 20 minutes before departure. This does not verify a 45-minute early-arrival rule, a selected train, fare, or duration.
routes.transferNote: Allow time to reach Seoul Station from the Myeongdong hotel; that route/time depends on the exact hotel entrance and train departure.

routes.title: Busan Station → L7 Haeundae
routes.route: Hotel-published bus choices: Express 1003 from Busan Station to Haeundae Beach (about 45 minutes, then a 3-minute walk to the beach entrance) or Express 1001 to Haeundae Station (about 50 minutes, then a 10-minute walk to the beach entrance). Busan Metro alternative: Line 1 from Busan Station to Seomyeon, then Line 2 to Haeundae, using the official map/planner.
routes.confirmedDuration: Bus estimates above are from L7's official location page and refer to named stops/beach entrance, not a confirmed hotel door-to-door total.
routes.officialDetails: L7 publishes the bus alternatives and approximate times. Busan Transportation Corporation's map confirms Busan Station on Line 1, Haeundae on Line 2, and Seomyeon as a transfer station.
routes.transferNote: Check live bus traffic and confirm the final hotel walk. Exact subway duration and fare remain blank.

routes.title: L7 Haeundae → Haeundae Traditional Market
routes.mode: Local walk / Busan Metro route check
routes.route: Use the official hotel address and the market's official address as map endpoints; Haeundae Station is on Busan Metro Line 2. No door-to-door walking time or path is stated.
routes.officialDetails: The hotel and KTO market pages confirm their respective addresses; the Busan metro map confirms the Haeundae station/Line 2 anchor.
routes.transferNote: Check current map access and the market vendor's opening status for the date.
